content_zh:
有那么一两次，男子似乎放松了盯防，她还是硬生生忍下了逃跑的诱惑。
不经意间看到男子微微挑起的眉，乔昭心中泛凉。
果然不出所料，在这人来人往的地方，男子只会对她看得更严，表面放松不过是看她是真老实还是假老实罢了。
男子忽然停下来，指着路边一家酒肆道：“咱们就在这吃。”
乔昭没有动。
男子拧起眉，心道小丫头莫非还不死心？
“快点进去，等会儿还要赶路呢！”男子一边催，一边伸手去拽乔昭。
小姑娘手一抬，指向前方不远处一栋三层酒楼，声音娇柔如糯米甜酒在人心头一点点发酵：“你说带我去上好的酒楼用饭的，这里不好。”
男子脸一黑。
那可是宝陵最好的酒楼，吃一顿可不便宜。
他这一迟疑，小姑娘一双清澈眸子立刻蕴满了泪水，倔强道：“你骗人，说带我去上好的酒楼，这家酒肆根本不上台面！”
眼下正是饭点，进出的人颇多，小姑娘声音微扬，立刻就有不少人看过来，站在酒肆门口的伙计显然听见了那番话，已然变了脸色，抬脚过来赶人。
男子脸色微变。
他想起在京城花朝节上拐走这小丫头时她身上的好衣料，心知小丫头出身非富即贵，看不上这路边酒肆也是正常。
“你答应过的，我就要在那家酒楼吃。谁知道这酒肆干不干净呀，万一吃出苍蝇来——”
酒肆伙计已经三两步来到近前，气呼呼道：“去去去，不吃别挡在门口！”
说着狠狠瞪男子一眼：“怎么管孩子的！”
乔昭才不理伙计怎么说，惊呼一声道：“哎呀，你看，这小二哥手指缝里还有油渍呢，脖子上搭的汗巾也发黑……”
她声音婉转动听，语速虽快，进出酒肆的人依然听得分明，立刻就有两人迟疑一下，本想进去吃饭的，抬脚转去了旁家。
酒肆不大，出来一探究竟的老板娘听到这话，抽出别在腰间的擀面杖就冲过来了。

乔昭年纪小，老板娘不跟她计较，擀面杖直接奔着男子去了。
男子见状不好，拽着喋喋不休的乔昭撒腿就跑。
二人一口气跑到酒楼前才停下来，男子指着乔昭，气得说不出话来。
乔昭一脸无辜：“我饿了。”
男子吐出一口气。
罢了罢了，醉仙居的酒菜虽贵，把这丫头一卖什么都赚回来了，眼看已快成事，还是少节外生枝。
“进去吧！”男子狠狠瞪乔昭一眼。
二人衣着普通，伙计没有往楼上领，就在大厅空出的位置坐下来。
“客官吃什么？”
男子还未开口，一道娇柔的声音响起：“江米酿鸭子。”
伙计一愣，不由看向男子。
“我要吃江米酿鸭子。”乔昭同样看向男子，目光执着。
男子头皮发麻，问伙计：“这道菜有吗？”
“有是有，就是等的工夫长些。”
赶在乔昭开口前，男子挥手道：“就要这个，再随意上两样小菜并酒水。”
不多时男子点的酒菜端上来，他拿起筷子开吃，乔昭则坐得笔直等着。
约莫两刻钟后，桌上只剩下杯盘狼藉，那道江米酿鸭子才终于端上来。
“祖宗，吃吧！”男子压低声音，咬牙切齿。
乔昭从袖中抽出帕子，找伙计要了一杯白水，打湿帕子净手。
男子忍不住嘀咕：“瞎讲究什么，之前风餐露宿不是也没事儿？”

乔昭抬眸，嫣然一笑：“有条件时，当然要让自己舒服些。”
男子被那忽然绽放的笑容晃得眼花，暗暗咂舌：乖乖不得了，小丫头才多大，这一笑竟让他险些失神。
他冷眼看乔昭不疾不徐用饭，越看越是心喜。
小丫头这股穷讲究劲儿，等她将来长大了，那些人就吃这一套。
有这等潜力，他自然能卖个好价钱。
这样一想，等待似乎没那么枯燥了。
男子的反应不出乔昭意料，她求的，就是能缓缓吃这顿饭。男子觉得她有价值，又因为快要成事不愿多生波折，自然会对她多些耐心。
乔昭小口小口吃得极慢，偶尔的，目光会从大厅里掠过，不经意间在通往二楼的楼梯处停驻瞬息，如蜻蜓点水。
不知等了多久，男子很是不耐时，脚步声从楼梯拐角处响起，很快便有三人踩着木质楼梯往下走来。
三人仿佛磁石，瞬间吸引住大厅里的目光。厅内陡然一静，就连一直对乔昭严防死守的男子这一瞬间都忘了眨眼，盯着其中一位紫衣男子猛瞧。

content_en:
Once or twice, the man seemed to relax his guard, but she still resisted the temptation to run away.
Inadvertently seeing the man's slightly raised eyebrows, Qiao Zhao felt cold in his heart.
As expected, in this place where people come and go, the man will only look at her more strictly. The superficial relaxation is just to see whether she is really honest or fake.
The man suddenly stopped, pointed to a wine shop on the roadside and said, "Let's eat here."
Qiao Zhao didn't move.
The man frowned and wondered, could the little girl not give up?
"Hurry in, we have to hurry up later!" the man urged, reaching out to pull Qiao Zhao.
The little girl raised her hand and pointed to a three-story restaurant not far ahead. Her voice was as gentle as glutinous rice wine fermenting in people's hearts: "You said you would take me to a good restaurant to eat, but this place is not good."
The man's face darkened.
That is the best restaurant in Baoling, and a meal is not cheap.
As soon as he hesitated, the little girl's clear eyes immediately filled with tears, and she said stubbornly: "You lied to me and said you would take me to a good restaurant. This restaurant is not good at all!"
It was dinner time, and there were a lot of people coming in and out. The little girl raised her voice slightly, and many people immediately looked over. The waiter standing at the door of the wine shop obviously heard what he said, and his expression changed, and he came over to chase people away.
The man's face changed slightly.
He remembered the good clothes the little girl was wearing when he abducted her at the Flower Festival in the capital. He knew that the little girl was born into either wealth or wealth, so it was normal for her to look down on this roadside wine shop.
"As you promised, I will eat at that restaurant. Who knows if this restaurant is clean? If flies come out of the food -"
The waiter from the wine shop had already come closer in a few steps and shouted angrily: "Go, go, don't block the door if you don't want to eat!"
Then he glared at the man fiercely: "Why do you care about the child?"
Qiao Zhaocai ignored what the waiter said and exclaimed: "Oh, look, this little second brother still has oil stains in his fingers, and the sweat towel on his neck is also black..."
Her voice was soft and gentle, and even though she spoke quickly, people who were entering and exiting the restaurant could still hear her clearly. Two people immediately hesitated for a moment, and the one who wanted to go in to eat turned around and went to another house.
The wine shop was not big, so when the proprietress who came out to investigate heard this, she took out the rolling pin from her waist and rushed over.
Qiao Zhao was young, so the landlady ignored her and went straight to the man with the rolling pin.
Seeing that the situation was not good, the man dragged Qiao Zhao, who was chattering away, and ran away.
The two of them ran to the restaurant before stopping. The man pointed at Qiao Zhao and was so angry that he couldn't speak.
Qiao Zhao looked innocent: "I'm hungry."
The man let out a breath.
That's all. Although the food and drinks in Zui Xianju are expensive, this girl has made back everything she sold. It seems that things are almost done, but there are still a few unintended consequences.
"Go in!" The man glared at Qiao Zhao fiercely.
The two of them were dressed in ordinary clothes, and the waiter did not lead them upstairs, but sat down in the empty space in the hall.
"What do guests eat?"
Before the man could speak, a delicate voice sounded: "Duck stuffed with glutinous rice."
The guy was stunned and couldn't help but look at the man.
"I want to eat glutinous rice stuffed with duck." Qiao Zhao also looked at the man with persistent eyes.
The man's scalp was numb and he asked the waiter: "Do you have this dish?"
"Yes, there is, but the wait will be longer."
Before Qiao Zhao could speak, the man waved his hand and said, "I'll take this, and then I'll serve you two side dishes and drinks."
Not long after, the food and wine the man ordered were brought to him. He picked up his chopsticks and started eating, while Qiao Zhao sat up straight and waited.
About two-quarters of an hour later, when only the cups and plates were left on the table, the duck stuffed with glutinous rice was finally served.
"Ancestor, eat it!" The man lowered his voice and gritted his teeth.
Qiao Zhao took out the handkerchief from his sleeve, asked the waiter for a glass of water, wetted the handkerchief and washed his hands.
The man couldn't help but mutter: "What are you talking about? Wasn't it okay to sleep in the open air before?"
Qiao Zhao raised his eyes and smiled sweetly: "When conditions permit, of course I will let youMake yourself comfortable. "
The man was dazzled by the smile that suddenly bloomed, and secretly smacked his lips: You are so well behaved, the little girl is so young, this smile actually made him almost lose his mind.
He looked at Qiao Zhao with cold eyes as he ate slowly and leisurely, and the more he watched, the happier he became.
The little girl is so picky, and when she grows up, those people will do the same thing.
With such potential, he can naturally be sold at a good price.
Thinking about it this way, waiting doesn't seem so boring.
The man's reaction was not what Qiao Zhao expected. What she asked for was to be able to eat the meal slowly. The man feels that she is valuable, and because he is about to achieve something, he doesn't want to cause more troubles, so he will naturally be more patient with her.
Qiao Zhao ate slowly and slowly. Occasionally, his eyes would pass through the hall and inadvertently stop for a moment on the stairs leading to the second floor, like a dragonfly touching water.
After waiting for an unknown amount of time, the man became impatient. Footsteps sounded from the corner of the stairs, and soon three people were walking down the wooden stairs.
The three of them were like magnets, instantly attracting the attention of the hall. There was a sudden silence in the hall. Even the man who had been guarding Qiao Zhao for a moment forgot to blink and stared at one of the men in purple.
